summary: The root نَهَجَ (nahaja) primarily means for a road or affair to become clear or manifest. It also describes making something clear or following a path.
lane: 1 نَهَجَ ذ , (K, Msb,) aor. نَهَجَ , inf. n. نُهُوجٌ ; (Msb;) and ; (S, K;) It (a road, or way, S and Msb, and an affair, TA,) became manifest, plainly apparent, or open; (S, K, Msb,) and so, with respect to a road, . (K.) -b2- نَهَجَ , (S, K, Msb,) and , (K, Msb,) He, or it, rendered (a road, S and Msb, and an affair, TA,) manifest, plainly apparent, or open: (S, K, Msb:) -b3- إِعْمَلْ عَلَى مَا نَهَجْتُهُ لَكَ Do according to that which I have made manifest to thee. (S.) -A2- نَهَجَ , aor. نَهَجَ , (inf. n. نَهْجٌ ; TA,) and , It (attrition, TA) wore out, or rendered worn out, a garment. (K.) -b2- نَهِجَ , aor. نَهَجَ ; (A 'Obeyd, S, K;) and نَهَجَ , (K,) but this is disallowed by A 'Obeyd, (S,) and نَهُجَ , and ; (K;) It (a garment) became old and worn out: (K:) or signifies it began to become warn out: (S:) and it became old and worn out, but without being rent in several parts. (TA.) انهج فِيهِ البِلَى [ The effect of ] attrition spread through it. (IAar.) -A3- نَهَجَ الطَّرِيقَ He went along the road. (S, K.) -A4- نَهِجَ , aor. نَهَجَ , inf. n. نَهَجُ ; (S, K;) and نُهِجَ , inf. n. نَهْجَةٌ ; (ISh;) this inf. n. also mentioned by Lth, who knew no verb belonging to it; (L;) and نَهَجَ , aor. نَهِجَ , (K,) inf. n. نَهِيجٌ ; (L, in art. أنح ;) and , inf. n. إِنْهَاجٌ ; (L;) He was out of breath; breathed short, or unintermittedly; panted: (S, L, K;) by reason of violent motion: said of a man, and of a beast of carriage, (L,) and of a dog. (T.) One says, فَمَا أَدْرَِى مَا فُلَانٌ يَنْهَجُ فِى النَّفَسِ Such a one is out of breath. or breathes short, or unintermittedly, or pants for breath, and I know not what hath caused him to be so, or to do so. And it is said in a trad., رَأَى رَجُلًا يَنْهَجُ He saw a man breathing short, or unintermittedly, or panting for breath, by reason of fatness, and putting forth his tongue, from fatigue or the like. (S.)
